observations: A black mirrorless camera body is shown from the rear, resting on its original retail box.
The box is clearly marked 'Canon' and 'EOS R50' with 'RF-S 18-45mm F4.5-6.3 IS STM KIT' in photo 0.
The camera's articulating LCD screen is flipped out, showing a warning sticker on its reverse side.
No lens is visible on the camera body or elsewhere in the photo.
The box features a holographic security seal and a sticker with Chinese text.
Watermarks for 'Jiji' and 'Ericsson Business World' are present on the image.

claims.evidence: These are standard specifications for the EOS R50 model shown on the box, but the internal hardware and sensor resolution are not confirmed by a photo of the settings screen.
The physical size and weight cannot be verified from a single remote photo without a scale reference.

claims.claim: designed for beginners and content creators
claims.evidence: This is a marketing statement regarding the model's intended use and cannot be verified as a condition of the item.

risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional or have a faulty screen.

risks.risk: The image sensor may be scratched, dusty, or damaged.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the sensor with the body cap or lens removed.

risks.risk: The item may be a grey market import with no local manufacturer warranty.

Photo of the front of the camera body showing the model name.
Photo of the camera sensor with the cap removed.
response.reason: The camera is identified as a Canon EOS R50 from the retail packaging. It is priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional, body-only unit because the lens is not shown and there is no proof of operation.
